user.title: Choose vacuum
user.description: Creates a room queue for this vacuum and a dashboard card to control it.

rooms_clean_area.title: Rooms
rooms_clean_area.description: Rooms come from the area mapping of the vacuum (vacuum entity → settings → map areas to segments). Optionally limit and order the rooms offered in the card; leave empty for all mapped rooms.

rooms_script.title: Script and rooms
rooms_script.description: This vacuum can't be sent to a single room by Home Assistant directly, so a script does it: it is started once per room with the variables `area_id`, `area_name` and `vacuum_entity_id` and must send the vacuum to that room. Example in the README.

mapping_missing.title: Rooms not mapped yet
mapping_missing.description:
{vacuum} can clean single areas, but none of its segments is mapped to a Home Assistant area yet, so there would be no rooms to queue.

Open the vacuum entity → settings → map areas to segments, assign the segments, then choose **Check again**.

menu_options.use_script: Use an own script per room instead

mapping_unnamed.title: Rooms not named yet
mapping_unnamed.description:
{vacuum} can clean single areas, but none of its segments is mapped to a Home Assistant area yet. Its segments only carry numbers, so the mapping dialog would not show which segment is which room.

1. Name the rooms in the vacuum's own app (Valetudo: web interface → map → edit segments).
2. Open the vacuum entity → settings → map areas to segments and assign them.
3. Choose **Check again**.

init.title: How the vacuum gets to a room
init.description:
**Directly (recommended):** Home Assistant sends the vacuum straight to the room. Needs a vacuum that supports this and whose segments are mapped to areas.

**With an own script:** for vacuums that can't do this – you write a script that sends the vacuum to one room.

rooms_clean_area.description: Rooms come from the area mapping of the vacuum (vacuum entity → settings → map areas to segments). Optionally limit and order the rooms offered in the card; leave empty for all mapped rooms.

data_description.start_timeout: How long the vacuum may take to start cleaning after it was sent to a room, before the card reports "did not start". Stations that wash or dry the mops first need a few minutes.
